subject.title: fix: require decimal numeric oc-path predicates

question: Should relational `oc-path` predicates intentionally change from accepting all finite `Number(...)`-coercible operands to accepting only the new decimal-only literal grammar?
rationale: The proposed implementation changes the accepted query language, so tests can prove either behavior but cannot determine which existing-user contract OpenClaw should preserve.

options.title: Preserve finite-number compatibility
options.body: Keep the current finite-number grammar and fix only blank or whitespace coercion, preserving established exponent and hexadecimal query behavior.

options.title: Adopt decimal-only predicates
options.body: Accept the syntax restriction as an intentional compatibility change and add maintainer-approved user-facing contract and upgrade documentation.

recommendation.title: Preserve finite-number compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep the current finite-number grammar and fix only blank or whitespace coercion, preserving established exponent and hexadecimal query behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline indicates involvement in this review cycle, and the unresolved choice is product compatibility direction.
